name: Hiiragi Yuka
source: One of [url=/c83148]Ryou's[/url] classmates and [url=/c3229]Saori's[/url] best friend. An energetic girl who's popular with both girls and boys. She is an excellent swimmer and is hyped up to become the swimming club's next president. Despite her masculine hobbies and likes she has a girly side to her as well.
